laterChanges: Enacted 2026 law replaces the general credit with a homestead exemption from assessment2026/pay2027 onward.
For rent base year 2026, claimed in 2027, the enacted law raises the tax-equivalent base to $1,500. The owner base increases for fiscal-year 2027–2028 taxes; these changes do not apply to 2025 rent.
name: Iowa
overview: Iowa combines a general homestead credit with income-tested owner relief and rent reimbursement.

programs.name: Homestead Tax Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: Before funding adjustments: levy on the first $4,850 of homestead value, with a $62.50 minimum, limited to qualified ordinary taxes.
programs.formulaSummary: Levy-based credit, separate from assessed-value exemptions.
programs.application: File homestead claim with local assessor; qualifying claims continue.
eligibilityNotes: Ownership, occupancy, and Iowa-residency conditions apply.
The statutory minimum cannot exceed ordinary homestead tax; special assessments do not enlarge that cap.
programs.programYear: Assessment-year 2025 baseline; property-tax fiscal payment cycle differs.

sources.title: 2025 Iowa Code §425.1, credit amount and tax limit

programs.name: Property Tax Credit for Senior and Disabled Citizens
programs.ageRule: Age 65+, or totally disabled age 18+; expanded calculation at age 70+.
programs.incomeDefinition: Prior-year household income under claim instructions, including specified nontaxable amounts.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025 claim: ordinary income table below $26,219; age70+ route below 250% of poverty guideline.
programs.maximumBenefit: Ordinary credit uses up to $1,000 of taxes; age70+ tax-growth alternative can differ.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-table percentage of capped tax base, less general homestead credit; age70+ may use greater tax-growth calculation.
programs.application: File 2025 Form 54-001 with county treasurer by June 1, subject to extension.
eligibilityNotes: 2025 claim form uses 2024 income and age.
Eligible mobile homes may follow a separate reduced-tax-rate route.
interactions: General Homestead Credit is subtracted in the claim calculation; do not sum unadjusted credits.
programs.programYear: 2025 claim using 2024 income, applied to fiscal-year 2025–2026 taxes.

programs.name: Rent Reimbursement
programs.ageRule: Funded HHS program serves age65+ residents and qualifying disabled adults.
programs.incomeDefinition: Annual household income under HHS instructions.
programs.maximumBenefit: 2025 maximum $1,000, subject to income schedule and qualifying rent.
programs.formulaSummary: Apply the income-table percentage to the lesser of 23% of qualified rent and the $1,000 tax-equivalent base.
programs.application: Apply through Iowa HHS beginning January 2026 for 2025 rent.
eligibilityNotes: Statutory broader age23/head-of-household extension has distinct funding rules; HHS currently describes senior/disabled eligibility.
interactions: A dual owner/renter claim shares the $1,000 tax-equivalent base, with owner taxes applied first. Rent base year 2025 pairs with owner claim year 2026.
programs.programYear: 2025 rent and income; applications open in 2026.

programs.name: Additional senior homestead exemption
programs.ageRule: Age65+ by January1 of assessment year.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces taxable value before levy-based credits.

programs.name: Disabled Veteran Homestead Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: Qualifying permanent100% service-connected disability, compensated individual unemployability, or eligible survivor.
programs.formulaSummary: Offsets qualifying taxes on the eligible homestead.
programs.application: File disabled-veteran claim with assessor by July1.
eligibilityNotes: Veteran ownership/occupancy, VA documentation, and surviving-beneficiary rules apply.
For pre-July2026 applications, acreage/appurtenance rules differ from new2026 applications.
interactions: Coordinate credits on the underlying bill; relief cannot exceed eligible taxes.

researchNotes: Owner 2025 claims use 2024 income; renter claim-year2025 uses 2025 income. These are not the same income window.
Levy and prior-tax-liability inputs are necessary for complete owner calculations.

The HHS manual’s $17,000-income example uses 50%, matching its 2024 table, without naming a base year. Its 2025 table lists 70% at that income. Funding, final rounding and specified age-70 source conflicts remain unresolved; this profile does not provide a validated award.
